description: Change one finished video as the person asks, made again into a new video beside it, as the app's Change does. This spends the team's credits: the price get_video lists in after_steps as change_video, refunded if it fails. Only for a video whose after_steps offers it. What to change is the person's own words; a change the video cannot be made with at all is answered with why and spends nothing. Answers an id at once: call get_video with it about once a minute until its status is ready or failed.

change.description: What to change, in the person's words, on one line.

credits.description: The credits after_steps lists for change_video; a different figure is refused.

id.description: The id of a finished video, from make_video or list_videos.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this video. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments answers as the first call did and spends nothing more.

part.description: Which of its videos, as get_video names it: v1, the default, v2 and on.

name: change_video
title: Change a video
